documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation

analysis.summary: Sky Gold & Diamonds reported strong consolidated financial results for Q2 and H1 FY27, driven by robust volume growth, higher export contributions, and a strategic shift toward value-added studded jewelry and advance gold models. The company emphasized its asset-light model, institutionalized internal processes, and strong working capital management resulting in positive operating cash flow. Management noted that under SEBI guidelines, forward-looking guidance is not provided, but highlighted the successful integration of past acquisitions and steady long-term execution. Sky Gold & Diamonds Limited reported strong financial performance for Q2 and H1 FY27, with revenue from operations reaching Rs 2,390.7 crore and Rs 4,403.5 crore respectively. Management highlighted strategic growth drivers such as the expansion of value-added products, export growth in regions like the Middle East, and the scaling of the asset-light Advance Gold model.

guidance.claim: The company remains on track to achieve its FY27 revenue target of INR 8,100 crores.
guidance.quote: We remain firmly on track to achieve our aspiration of INR8,100 crores by FY27 and INR18,000 crores to INR19,000 crores by FY30.

guidance.claim: Management plans to revise its FY27 revenue target after Diwali.
guidance.quote: So, we will revise our target after Diwali.

guidance.claim: Long-term projections target an operating cash flow to PAT conversion of close to 20% and an overall PAT margin of close to 5%.
guidance.quote: And our overall PAT margin will be close to 5%.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that consumers are shifting from 22-karat jewelry to 18-karat, 14-karat, and 9-karat due to higher gold prices and generational preferences.
demand_outlook.quote: Every quarter, we are seeing that there's a drastic change in the karatage shift from 22-karat shifting to 18-karat, 18-karat shifting to 14-karat and 9-karat.

demand_outlook.claim: Lower karatage products like 18 KT, 14 KT, and 9 KT have been gaining market share due to gold price appreciation.
demand_outlook.quote: Lower KT products like 18 KT, 14 KT, 9 KT have been gaining market share due to appreciation in appreciation.

demand_outlook.claim: Participation in the Asiana U.K. India Jewellery Expo in London resulted in a prospective order pipeline of approximately INR 30 crores to INR 45 crores.
demand_outlook.quote: The response was highly encouraging, resulting in strong initial interest and helping us to build a prospective order pipeline of approximately INR30 crores to INR45 crores across the U.K. and European markets.

demand_outlook.claim: Natural diamonds currently contribute approximately 2% of the overall business.
demand_outlook.quote: Further, natural diamonds currently contribute approximately 2% of our overall business, presenting significant headroom for future growth.

capex_expansion.claim: Current capacity utilization is around 55% to 57%, which is sufficient till 2028.
capex_expansion.quote: Currently, the capacity utilization is close to 55%- 57%. And looking at the current projection numbers, we are good till 2028.

capex_expansion.claim: Future facility expansion post-2028 will follow a leased model with an estimated capex of INR 80 crores to INR 100 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: It will be close to INR80 crores to INR100 crores, which will be just 20% to 25% of the PAT that we will generate at that point of time, since we have already built a world-class facility and we have already invested in the capacity and infrastructure.

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated gross profit for Q2 FY27 reached INR229 crores with gross margins expanding by 133 basis points year-on-year to 9.6%.
margins_costs.quote: Gross profit was INR229 crores, up 87%. Gross margin expanded 133 basis points to 9.6% versus Q2 FY26.

margins_costs.claim: Operating costs rose to 1.6% of sales due to investments in human resources, including a CEO, design team, and audit and finance functions.
margins_costs.quote: Operating costs rose to 1.6% of sales, as we invested in people: a CEO, a larger design team, and stronger audit and finance functions.

margins_costs.claim: The share of value-added products has increased and served as the primary driver for gross margin expansion.
margins_costs.quote: Margin Expansion: Reflecting our strengthening merchandising capabilities, our Value-Added share of business has increased in the recent period serving as the primary driver for gross margin expansion.

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated gross margin increased to 9.3% in Q1 FY27 compared to 9.1% in Q4 FY26.
margins_costs.quote: Our consolidated gross margin increased to 9.3% in Q1 FY27 versus 9.1% in Q4 FY26, an improvement of 27 basis points.

margins_costs.claim: Profitability is protected against gold price volatility due to a strict back-to-back hedging policy.
margins_costs.quote: At that time, I had also emphasized that our profitability is not dependent on movements in gold prices because we follow strict back-to-back hedging policy.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA increased to 7.8% for the quarter.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA increased to INR157 crores, to 7.8% for the quarter.

orders_capacity.quote: So, 1.2 tons is our capacity to produce, and we are 60% approx utilization in the last quarter.

capital_allocation.claim: Net debt in the first half of FY27 decreased by 20% compared to FY26 levels when factoring in the land sale.
capital_allocation.quote: In fact, if we factor in the land sale we guided for earlier, net debt in first half FY27 is down 20% from FY26 level.

capital_allocation.claim: H1 operating cash flow stood at INR136 crores, representing 58% of H1 PAT.
capital_allocation.quote: H1 operating cash flow was INR136 crores, against the outflow of INR100.9 crores in H1 last year. This is 58% of H1 PAT, well ahead of the 20% OCF to PAT conversion we guided earlier.

capital_allocation.claim: Promoters will not draw salaries from FY27, and all promoter payouts will be solely through dividends generated from operating cash flows.
capital_allocation.quote: In line with our cash-first philosophy and uncompromising governance standards, promoters will not draw salaries from FY27, all promoter payouts will be solely through dividends generated from operating cash flows.

capital_allocation.claim: Net debt level for the quarter stood at INR 540 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: Net debt level for this quarter is INR540 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: Beginning FY27, the company will adopt a zero-salary promoter compensation model linked entirely to dividends.
capital_allocation.quote: Beginning FY27, we will adopt a zero-salary promoter compensation model.

risks_headwinds.claim: An exceptional charge of INR7.35 crores was recorded for a fraud incident at subsidiary Star Mangalsutra, against which INR3.35 crores was recovered and the balance provided.
risks_headwinds.quote: This is after an exceptional charge of INR7.35 crores for the fraud incident at our subsidiary, Star Mangalsutra, disclosed in July. Of the INR10.70 crores involved, INR3.35 crores has been recovered, and the balance is fully provided this quarter.

risks_headwinds.claim: Heightened volatility in gold prices created margin pressures across retailers and manufacturers in the jewelry industry.
risks_headwinds.quote: In recent quarters, heightened volatility in gold prices has created margin pressures across various retailers and manufacturers within the jewelry industry.

management_commitments.claim: Promoters committed to taking a salary only when there are operating cash flows.
management_commitments.quote: Promoters will only take salary when there is operating cash flows.

management_commitments.claim: Promoters intend to purchase the land if no final buyer commitment is received within 20 to 30 days.
management_commitments.quote: If we don't get a final commitment in this next 20 or 30 days, the promoters will purchase.

management_commitments.claim: Promoters will not draw salaries from FY27 onwards, with all promoter payouts made solely through dividends.
management_commitments.quote: In line with our cash-first philosophy and uncompromising governance standards, promoters will not draw salaries from FY27, all promoter payouts will be solely through dividends generated from operating cash flows.

management_commitments.claim: The company aims to reach an Advance Gold model share of 15% for FY27, 20% next year, 25% in the third year, and 30% by 2030.
management_commitments.quote: We have achieved 18% Advance Gold business, and we have given him the target for this year to be average of 15%, next year 20%, and the third year of 25%. In 2030, we will achieve 30% of the Advance Gold business, which we have given him set the target.

management_commitments.claim: The company aims to reduce or improve working capital days to reach 52 days by 2030 under Sky Gold Vision 2030.
management_commitments.quote: with an overall target to reach 52 days by 2030 in the Sky Gold Vision 2030 that we are looking at.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets achieving a net debt-free balance sheet and operations by 2030.
management_commitments.quote: By 2030, our aspiration is to build a company that is net debt-free, operations with a highly efficient balance sheet, maintains industry-leading working capital metrics and consistently converts a significant portion of its earnings into sustainable operating cash flows.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
